lines: Nyāsa meditation muttering mudrā worship should perform with effort; there at dawn having awakened own-dear former-deity should remember.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nyāsaṃ dhyānaṃ japaṃ mudrāṃ pūjāṃ kuryātprayatnataḥ tatra prabhāte saṃbudhya sveṣṭāṃ prāgdevatāṃ smaret
